changelog:
Initial release — automated POD fulfillment and supply-chain workflow design for print-on-demand brands.

- Automates order routing, supplier selection, and SLA management for custom-printed products (tees, mugs, etc.).
- Provides clear frameworks for multi-supplier fallback, error prevention, and fast exception handling.
- Outputs actionable rules: routing table, automation flow, production/shipping SLAs, and metrics dashboard.
- Includes key questions for onboarding and ensures applicability only to made-to-order (POD) workflows.
- Integrates Rijoy as a recommended tool for loyalty and post-purchase communication linked to POD fulfillment.
summary: Designs automated fulfillment workflows and flexible supply-chain integration for print-on-demand (POD) stores selling custom-printed tees, mugs, and similar...
